panel.title: Board settings
panel.help: This private panel configures only this channel’s board. Each change takes effect immediately. The limit is 50 active timers.
panel.alertsHelp: Choose when to alert the group and which roles to notify. These preferences are kept when you disable alerts.
panel.notificationsHelp: Silent mode suppresses push notifications, including for mentioned roles.
panel.rolesHelp: Add or remove roles one at a time (up to {{max}}). A role must be mentionable, or PICKET must have permission to mention all roles.
panel.rolesUnavailable: Unable to verify roles right now. Try again.
panel.changesHelp: Officers and administrators always keep these permissions.
panel.purgeHelp: Permanently removes struck or expired timers after the chosen delay. 0 disables this cleanup.
panel.purgeConfirm: Delete struck or expired timers after {{hours}} h? Those already past this delay will be deleted as soon as the setting is applied. This deletion is permanent.
panel.warHelp: Reset this board for each new war. Timers created after the war begins are preserved.
panel.disableHelp: PICKET will stop sending new alerts for this board. Timers remain tracked, and existing alert messages can still be acknowledged.
panel.everyoneHelp: Add the @everyone role to the roles to notify? It represents every server member.
panel.syncPending: Display update pending. Your data is saved; PICKET retries automatically.
panel.expired: This panel has expired or its board has changed. Run /timers settings again in the board’s channel.

data.departureRequested: Your request is recorded: PICKET will leave this server and its data is scheduled for deletion on <t:{{timestamp}}:F> (<t:{{timestamp}}:R>). Discord messages are not deleted.
data.exportHelp: Download a JSON file of this server’s settings, permissions, audit records, boards, timers and application logs, plus Stats settings, tracking preferences and member summaries over 60 days. Pending voice data is counted per member; raw voice events and individual segments are not included. Audit and application logs and timer history are retained for 30 days. Todolists stay in Discord.
data.exportReady: 📥 Here is your server’s data. This file is visible only to you. It includes Discord identifiers: keep it private. No settings were changed.
data.exportTooLarge: The complete export exceeds the {{limitMb}} MB upload limit. No partial file was sent. Contact the PICKET operator to obtain your data.
data.cancelled: The scheduled deletion has been cancelled. PICKET is active again.
data.nothingScheduled: No deletion is scheduled for this server.

panel.title: PICKET · Server settings
panel.homeHelp: Choose the language and modules for your server. Each change takes effect immediately.
panel.expired: This panel has expired. Open /picket settings again.
panel.owner: This panel belongs to another user. Open /picket settings yourself.
panel.auto: Automatic — follows each user’s Discord language
panel.languageHelp: **Automatic** follows each person’s Discord language, then the server language, then English. Choose a **fixed language** so PICKET uses the same language for everyone.
panel.timersHelp: Track deadlines and receive alerts from your boards.
panel.todolistsHelp: Share task lists to check off in Discord.
panel.disableHelp:
Interactions and background processing for this module will stop.

**Existing data is retained.**
panel.reserved: The time zone is saved for future functionality and has no operational effect today.
panel.auditHelp: Publishes configuration changes, todolist creations, timer creations and removals, and alert acknowledgements. Todolist contents and countdown restarts are excluded.
panel.readOnly: Only administrators can change these permissions.
panel.restrictHelp: Add a member role before removing @everyone if members should retain access.
panel.everyoneHelp: Every member of this server will be able to use member commands. Officer access remains restricted.
panel.deletionHelp:
Confirming **makes PICKET leave this server** and immediately schedules data deletion. After the configured retention period, server settings, access roles, timers, history and audit logs are **permanently erased**.

Discord messages, including todolists, are **not automatically deleted**.
panel.deleteTitle: Remove PICKET and schedule permanent data deletion?

panel.recovery: To cancel data deletion, invite PICKET back before the deadline, then open /picket settings → Data as a server administrator. Other settings remain unavailable until cancellation.
panel.legacy: Commands have moved to this panel. No old command arguments were applied.
